requirements.requirement: The system must fetch comparison data from the EVAL-COMPARE API when two or more providers are selected.
The system must pass provider identifiers in the API request in the format defined by the comparison schema contract.
The system must render a loading state while awaiting the API response.
The system must display the comparison UI component populated with API data upon successful response.
The system must update the comparison view when the selected provider set changes without requiring a full page reload.
The system must maintain comparison state (selected providers and results) in a centralized state store or component state.
The system must prevent duplicate provider entries in the comparison selection.
The system must display an error state if the API request fails due to network or server error.
The system must display a user-friendly message when fewer than two providers are selected for comparison.
The system must retry or allow manual retry of the API call after a failed request.
The system must ensure API responses are mapped to the comparison UI schema without runtime errors.
The system must handle partial API responses by rendering available provider data and indicating missing fields.
The system must debounce rapid provider selection changes to avoid excessive API calls.
The system must log API request and response events for debugging purposes.
The system must allow LLM-generated comparison summaries to be displayed if provided in the API response.
The system must ensure LLM-generated text is clearly distinguishable from structured metric data in the UI.
The system must not block rendering of structured comparison data if LLM-generated content is missing or delayed.
The system must sanitize any LLM-generated content before rendering to prevent unsafe or malformed output.
The system must update LLM-generated comparison summaries when the provider selection changes.
The system must fall back to a deterministic comparison view if LLM-generated summaries fail to load or error.
